description: Saves the outcomes of practice exercises the learner actually attempted. confirmed records that the learner approved saving each included result, including failures; Polidict does not grade answers and stores the reported rating and whether it came from model assessment or learner self-assessment. Pass the batch's practiceId and a new requestId per submission; identical retries are idempotent. Each result needs the word's latest expectedVersion; a stale version returns WORD_CHANGED without saving. The response's progressSaved=true confirms the save, and updatedItems carries the new versions.

confirmed.description: True when the learner saw each included result and agreed to save it.

languageCode.description: Code of the learning language, for example en-GB or es-ES.

expectedVersion.description: Opaque revision token from the latest read or save of this item. A stale token returns WORD_CHANGED or GROUP_CHANGED without saving.

rating.description: Outcome of the attempt: AGAIN for incorrect or forgotten, HARD for correct with difficulty, GOOD for correct recall, EASY for recall the learner reported as effortless.

name: submit_training_results
title: Save practice results
